subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to safely reconfigure and recover their LLM provider settings

question: Should an authorized agent session be allowed to stage and activate provider/model and credential-reference changes, with a narrowly scoped recovery operation that remains usable after the selected model fails?
rationale: Existing code settles validation, write concurrency, failover, and operator repair, but not whether an agent may hold durable authority over the provider and credential-routing boundary.

options.title: Keep Operator Control
options.body: Keep provider mutation and recovery in CLI, Control UI, setup, and doctor while agents may only recommend exact actions.

options.title: Add Scoped Transactions
options.body: Permit explicit user-approved provider transactions with live probing, atomic activation, auditing, and bounded rollback.

options.title: Allow Autonomous Recovery
options.body: Give agents standing authority to change and restore provider configuration without per-change operator approval.

recommendation.title: Keep Operator Control
recommendation.body: Keep provider mutation and recovery in CLI, Control UI, setup, and doctor while agents may only recommend exact actions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership of gateway configuration and model-fallback hardening makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the cross-cutting decision.
